title: Permission ledger harmonization and canary fallbacks for RBAC v2 migration
creator: Anika Rao
description: Scope: This ticket defines a pragmatic, telemetry-gated approach to migrate permission state from RBAC v1 to RBAC v2 for customer orgs. The strategy emphasizes: 1) a streaming backfill that incrementally harmonizes the permission ledger, 2) dual-write during the canary phase with per-org feature flags, 3) strict audit-event compatibility and augmentation for SSO/SAML-derived attributes, and 4) a lightweight admin fallback mode for emergency access and safe rollback. Goals: - No customer-facing permission regressions during migration windows. - End-to-end audit trail continuity (RBAC v1 -> RBAC v2 events) for compliance. - Clear rollback and emergency admin pathways with minimal blast radius. Out-of-scope: user-facing UI redesigns and long-term permission schema refactors beyond required migration mappings.
comments: 2026-03-02 - Kickoff: aligned with PM and Security on telemetry gating thresholds (error rate < 0.5% over 24h, authz-deny delta < 0.1% on sampled requests). Action: engineering to implement sampling and gated dashboards.

2026-03-04 - Design review: agreed to extend audit event schema to include v1_origin, mapping_hint, and canonical_role_id. Confluence doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/rbacv2/permission-harmonization (internal).

2026-03-06 - Implementation note: streaming backfill implemented as a separate consumer in kafka-auth-permissions; consumer writes to v2-queue with idempotent keys and emits backfill-progress events to telemetry service. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/9421

2026-03-08 - Security review feedback: ensure SAML attribute mapping preserves original_name_id and includes assertion_id in audit events for traceability. Added an automated verifier that cross-checks SSO mapping during dual-write canary.

2026-03-09 - Ops checklist: added canary rollout plan (10 orgs -> 100 orgs -> org percentage waves), emergency bypass flow for org-admins, and rollback triggers. Dashboard query examples and alert thresholds included in the playbook.

2026-03-10 - Decision: use feature-flag-per-org for dual-write; enable dual-write only after 95% pass rate on canary synthetic checks for 48h. Fallback will be a read-side override that directs reads to RBAC v1 until reconciliation completes.
